raw.rationale: KU-55933 is a potent ATM inhibitor that sensitizes cells to DNA damage but as a single agent in 5-day PRISM viability screens shows little lineage-selective killing, with ATM-loss or DNA-repair-defective lineages (e.g., some gastric, lung, and CNS lines) only modestly enriched. Published PRISM/CTRP data indicate no strong single-lineage selectivity, so probabilities remain near the low base rate with slight elevation for lineages enriched in ATM-pathway alterations.
